messages:
jamal: FYI I'm proposing a change to infra/modules/gpu_pool: rename `kms_alias` (string) -> `kms_config` (object) to support multi-key rotation per-tenant. This will be a schema bump, not backwards-compatible.
lia: Can you paste the proposed HCL? want to see shape. also impact on tfstate? :eyes:
jamal: sure — plan is:
```
variable "kms_config" {
  type = object({
    key_alias = string
    region    = optional(string)
    role_arn  = optional(string)
  })
}
# old `kms_alias` will be kept as a compatibility shim for 2 releases
```
kevin: big :+1: on object shape but we need a migration path. Many stacks set `kms_alias = null` or an interpolated var. How do we detect old usage in automation?
anna: we can add a pre-apply check in gitops pipeline that fails when module call uses `kms_alias` and suggests the new shape. Also a `terraform state mv` recipe for manual migration.
jamal: exactly. Proposed rollout:
1) Add `kms_config` variable and keep `kms_alias` var with deprecation warning in module outputs/log
2) Add reconciliation job in CI that runs `terraform plan` across all workspaces and captures uses of `kms_alias`
3) Run a one-time migration PR per workspace that sets `kms_config = { key_alias = var.kms_alias }` then remove shim after 2 release cycles
4) Canary apply to low-traffic GPU pools (dev/ci) then prod
kevin: is there KMS IAM role changes? role_arn optional in object — but if absent we default to existing IAM path, right?
jamal: yes default path unchanged. If `role_arn` provided, module will attach new kms:Decrypt permission to pool instances role. That requires an IAM role-binding change, which may need manual approval in some orgs.
oncall-nina: heads-up: binding changes trigger our compliance scans and might block apply for enterprise tenants. We need an exception flow documented.
devex-maya: can we add an automated migration helper script that opens PRs across repos and adds the `kms_config` block? We did this for subnet-tag rename last quarter.
anna: good idea. Also add a `tfstate-check` step that runs `terraform state list 'module.*.aws_kms_alias.*'` to verify alias resources remain intact.
terraform-bot: [plan summary] workspace=dev-gpu-pool, plan=NO_CHANGES (shim present), warnings: module/gpu_pool variable `kms_alias` is deprecated and will be removed in v3.0.0. (see RFC: https://go.redwood.ai/rfc/kms-struct)
lia: cost/regional impact — if we start supporting region in kms_config, some GPU pools in eu-west-1 used a cross-region alias workaround. Need to audit latency/cost for cross-region CMK usage.
kevin: also check provider aliasing. If someone used a provider alias for kms in a different account, the module should accept a `kms_provider` string to pass through `providers = { aws.kms = aws.account_b }` patterns.
jamal: noted — will add `kms_provider` optional string. Migration checklist (short):
- [ ] add shim in module and deprecation message
- [ ] add CI scan that lists workspaces using `kms_alias`
- [ ] helper script to open PRs with `kms_config` set
- [ ] docs + runbook for IAM binding exceptions
- [ ] canary apply to dev then prod; monitor node boot logs for kms decrypt errors
- [ ] remove `kms_alias` shim in v3.0.0 after 2 releases
devex-maya: I can take the helper script + PR template. I'll coordinate with infra-oncall to schedule canary windows.
oncall-nina: please include playbook lines for rescuing GPU nodes if kms decryption fails:
```
- check /var/log/cloud-init for KMS errors
- check instance role permissions
- fallback: attach temp key in same account and patch node via user-data
```
anna: +1 on including tests in our gitops CI that do a dry-run with plan detection for deprecated vars. We shouldn't let the deprecated var persist silently.
lia: sounds good. jamal can you open the RFC PR and link to the migration issues? I'll run the initial workspace scan this afternoon and post results.
jamal: will do. thanks everyone :rocket:
